# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(mgcv)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(splines)
library(janitor)

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)

select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r}
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
GSE234354_gene_annotations <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props.rds"))
```

-----

# Normalise counts

For visualisation purposes, remove batch effect

```{r}
rwh_phenotype <- phenotype %>% filter(! is.na(sample_id))
exprs <- GSE234354_counts[GSE234354_gene_annotations$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id]
ok <- rowMeans(cpm(exprs) > 0.5) > 0.2
table(ok)
gene_annotation <- GSE234354_gene_annotations[ok,]

y <- DGEList(GSE234354_counts[gene_annotation$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id], 
             genes=gene_annotation)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
nc <- cpm(y, log=TRUE)
```

```{r}
covariates <- model.matrix(~ rna_batch, data=rwh_phenotype)
nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, covariates=covariates[,-1])

# # Functionally the same as using the batch argument, but intercept for each 
# # gene is slightly different
# nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, batch=rwh_phenotype$rna_batch)
```

```{r}
X <- cSplineDes(rwh_phenotype$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
covariates <- model.matrix(~ X + rna_batch, data=rwh_phenotype)
nc_cc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, covariates=covariates[,-1])
```

# DGE

```{r}
y <- DGEList(GSE234354_counts[gene_annotation$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id], 
             genes=gene_annotation)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
nc <- cpm(y, log=TRUE)
```

```{r}
table(rwh_phenotype$ever_pregnant, useNA="always")
```

```{r}
pheno <- rwh_phenotype %>%
  mutate(age_scaled=scale(age)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cycle=case_when(
    time < 9 | time > 99 ~ "men",
    time < 59 ~ "pro",
    TRUE ~ "sec"
  ))  %>% 
  filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant)) %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(cycle, "_", ever_pregnant))
```

```{r}
table(pheno$ever_pregnant, useNA="always")
```

```{r}
table(pheno$ever_pregnant, pheno$cycle, useNA="always")
```

```{r}
table(pheno$rna_batch, pheno$group, useNA="always")
```

## By cycle stage

```{r}
X <- cSplineDes(pheno$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
f <- as.formula(formula)
design <- model.matrix(f, pheno)
```

```{r}
v <- voom(y[,pheno$sample_id], design)
fit <- lmFit(v, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit, robust=TRUE)
```

```{r}
decideTests(fit) %>% abs %>% colSums
```

```{r}
top_ever_pregnant <- topTable(fit, coef="ever_pregnant", n=Inf, sort.by="p")
```

```{r}
hist(top_ever_pregnant$P.Value, breaks=100)
```

```{r}
top_age <- list()
top_age[["men"]] <- topTable(fit, coef="age_scaled:cyclemen", n=Inf, sort.by="p")
top_age[["pro"]] <- topTable(fit, coef="age_scaled:cyclepro", n=Inf, sort.by="p")
top_age[["sec"]] <- topTable(fit, coef="age_scaled:cyclesec", n=Inf, sort.by="p")
```

```{r}
hist(top_age[["men"]]$P.Value, breaks=100)
hist(top_age[["pro"]]$P.Value, breaks=100)
hist(top_age[["sec"]]$P.Value, breaks=100)
```

```{r}
head(top_ever_pregnant)
head(top_age[["men"]])
head(top_age[["pro"]])
head(top_age[["sec"]])
```

```{r}
saveRDS(top_ever_pregnant, file=paste(output_dir, analysis_name, "_top_ever_pregnant.rds", sep=""))
saveRDS(top_age, file=paste(output_dir, analysis_name, "_top_age.rds", sep=""))
```

# ORA

```{r}
run_ora <- function(top_table, run_go=TRUE, run_kegg=FALSE,
                    run_reactome=FALSE, p_threshold=0.05,
                    directional=TRUE) {
  up_de <- top_table %>% filter(adj.P.Val < p_threshold, logFC > 0) %>%
    pull(entrez_id)
  down_de <- top_table %>% filter(adj.P.Val < p_threshold, logFC < 0) %>%
    pull(entrez_id)
  de <- top_table %>% filter(adj.P.Val < p_threshold) %>%
    pull(entrez_id)
  universe <- top_table$entrez_id
  results <- list()
  # qvalueCutoff=0.05 argument doesn't work... Filter manually afterwards
  if (run_go) {
    if (directional) {
      results[["up_go"]] <-
        enrichGO(up_de, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont="all",
                 universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
      results[["down_go"]] <-
        enrichGO(down_de, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont="all",
                 universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    } else {
      results[["go"]] <-
        enrichGO(de, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont="all",
                 universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    }
  }
  if (run_kegg) {
    if (directional) {
      results[["up_kegg"]] <-
        enrichKEGG(up_de, organism="hsa", universe=universe)
      results[["down_kegg"]] <-
        enrichKEGG(down_de, organism="hsa", universe=universe)
    } else {
      results[["kegg"]] <-
        enrichKEGG(de, organism="hsa", universe=universe)
    }
  }
  if (run_reactome) {
    if (directional) {
      results[["up_reactome"]] <-
        enrichPathway(gene=up_de, universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
      results[["down_reactome"]] <-
        enrichPathway(gene=down_de, universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    } else {
      results[["reactome"]] <-
        enrichPathway(gene=de, universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    }
  }
  return(results)
}
```


```{r}
run_ora_top_n <- function(top_table, run_go=TRUE, run_kegg=FALSE,
                    run_reactome=FALSE, n=100,
                    directional=TRUE) {
  up_de <- top_table %>% filter(logFC > 0) %>% arrange(P.Value) %>%
    pull(entrez_id) %>% head(n)
  down_de <- top_table %>% filter(logFC < 0) %>% arrange(P.Value) %>%
    pull(entrez_id) %>% head(n)
  de <- top_table %>% pull(entrez_id) %>% head(n)
  universe <- top_table$entrez_id
  results <- list()
  # qvalueCutoff=0.05 argument doesn't work... Filter manually afterwards
  if (run_go) {
    if (directional) {
      results[["up_go"]] <-
        enrichGO(up_de, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont="all",
                 universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
      results[["down_go"]] <-
        enrichGO(down_de, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont="all",
                 universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    } else {
      results[["go"]] <-
        enrichGO(de, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont="all",
                 universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    }
  }
  if (run_kegg) {
    if (directional) {
      results[["up_kegg"]] <-
        enrichKEGG(up_de, organism="hsa", universe=universe)
      results[["down_kegg"]] <-
        enrichKEGG(down_de, organism="hsa", universe=universe)
    } else {
      results[["kegg"]] <-
        enrichKEGG(de, organism="hsa", universe=universe)
    }
  }
  if (run_reactome) {
    if (directional) {
      results[["up_reactome"]] <-
        enrichPathway(gene=up_de, universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
      results[["down_reactome"]] <-
        enrichPathway(gene=down_de, universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    } else {
      results[["reactome"]] <-
        enrichPathway(gene=de, universe=universe, readable=TRUE)
    }
  }
  return(results)
}
```


### Ever pregnant

```{r}
top <- top_ever_pregnant
```

```{r}
ora_results <- run_ora_top_n(top,
  run_kegg=TRUE, run_reactome=FALSE, n=100)
```

```{r}
sapply(ora_results, function(x) {
  a <- x@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% nrow
  b <- x@geneSets %>% length
  sprintf("%d/%d", a, b)
})
```

```{r}
ora_results$up_go@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% head(50)
```

```{r}
ora_results$down_go@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% head(50)
```

```{r}
ora_results$up_kegg@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% head(50)
```

```{r}
ora_results$down_kegg@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% head(50)
```

```{r}
out_list <- lapply(ora_results, \(x) {x@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)})
saveRDS(out_list, file=paste(output_dir, analysis_name, "_ora_ever_pregnant.rds", sep=""))
```
